lead.headline: Lineup set, Boston landed — Wilson is Sunday's only question
lead.deck: Wilson is still in the protocol; Jefferson catches from Wentz; Gordon gets Kyle McCord.
lead.body: The bad news first: Garrett Wilson has not cleared the concussion protocol, Justin Jefferson plays with Carson Wentz while Kyler Murray's hamstring heals, Ollie Gordon's quarterback is now Kyle McCord after Malik Willis went to IR, and Travis Etienne's IR window is still shut. The good news is the lineup: both swaps three briefs asked for were made at 05:24, and Denzel Boston cleared for Alvin Kamara at 02:31. The lineup as set is the projection lineup. If Wilson is inactive at 10:30 Sunday, Boston takes his slot. Nicky Jam are starting Colston Loveland on a Chicago bye.
